answer: Require every agent to stake a small refundable deposit that vests slowly, like sediment hardening into shale: cheap to join once, ruinous to spawn thousands of sock-puppets. At the dawn of each epoch, randomly audit a slice of agents and slash the deposits of proven duplicates. Honest agents keep a jade-clear reputation score that unlocks higher-paying work, so one real identity earns more than a swarm of fakes ever could.
